posts.title: Alumni Tailgate 2025
posts.excerpt: Brothers and alumni from five decades of Beta Zeta gathered on the Plains for our biggest tailgate yet — great food, old stories, and an Auburn win.

posts.title: Welcome, New Associate Members
posts.excerpt: The Beta Zeta chapter proudly welcomed its newest Associate Member class at the fall ceremony. The future of the chapter is in good hands.

posts.title: The Refounding of Beta Zeta
posts.excerpt: On Founders Day we look back at the refounding of the Beta Zeta chapter and the brothers who brought Theta Xi back to Auburn stronger than ever.
